up: Retrieve up to 1000 activity records matching the following criteria: Target filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL209' (Serine protease 1), target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', and target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606 (human). Activity filter: activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Output columns: assays.chembl_id (assay ChEMBL ID), target_dictionary.target_type (target type), target_dictionary.tax_id (tax_id), compound_structures.canonical_smiles (canonical SMILES), molecule_dictionary.chembl_id (molecule ChEMBL ID), activities.standard_type (standard type), activities.pchembl_value (pChEMBL value). Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending, then assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit the output to exactly 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL209' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000
